text_block_list.text:
On our way back from a training session
at a track
in the city...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф comes to a halt in front
of a
display window.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I have been sleepwalking into disaster, it
seems...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The fruits of my indolence are beginning
to show.
I have put on weight.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: You look the same to me.

text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous. Can't you see how
the seams
of my skirt strain?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It appears the student council's clerical
duties
have done me no favors...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: But I must set an example for my fellow students in both action and appearance.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I must redress this as quickly as possible,
and I am
afraid you will have to assist
me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
After that, we work together on a diet
program
until Симболи Рудольф regains a
racing physique she
is satisfied with.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
